Based in the Netherlands, available for maternity and mother-and-baby sessions across the country. Partners and children are welcome. We discuss your preferences, privacy, location and the full proposal before confirming a date.

Before we begin

A few things
you may wonder.

When should I get in touch?

Whenever you start thinking about a session. Share your preferred period and we’ll discuss a date that works for you. The timing is personal and should suit your comfort.

Can my partner or children join?

Yes, we can include them in the plan. Tell me who you would like to bring so we can allow time for both individual portraits and photographs together.

Do I need a special dress?

No. A simple outfit you feel good in can be beautiful. We can discuss textures, colours and silhouettes once we have chosen the setting. Clothing hire is not included in the guide price.

Can the session be indoors?

Yes, we can discuss a suitable indoor setting or studio. Any hire fees are confirmed separately before booking.

Do you also photograph life after birth?

Yes. Postpartum sessions focus on you and your baby, including natural moments at home and feeding if you wish. Visit the postpartum page for the photographs, approach and planning details.

Planning your session

A little preparation.

Planning maternity photos: timing, comfort and location

Begin with how you want to remember this chapter: a quiet portrait on your own, a photograph with your partner, or an outdoor session with warm light. Then discuss a date and a setting that feel comfortable for you.
